title: selfcheck and backlog.py procs still call a fresh-transcript claude session an orphan: no caller passes fresh= to bl_procs.classify
goal: bl_selfcheck.check_orphans and backlog.py procs count a claude session whose transcript was written within the last 10 minutes as detached, as the sessions panel does, by passing fresh pids to bl_procs.classify (SP-fn7letri review G2 on ST-kxnlpycw clause 1).

run:
import json, os, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile, time, uuid
if os.name == "nt":
    print("check skipped: a fake claude process needs a POSIX host"); sys.exit(0)
R = os.getcwd(); T = os.path.realpath(tempfile.mkdtemp()); C = os.path.join(T, "cfg")
env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith("GIT_")}
env.update(CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=C, KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(T, "coord.sqlite"))
def sh(*a, cwd=T):
    return subprocess.run(a, cwd=cwd, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
K = os.path.join(T, "clone"); os.makedirs(K)
sh("git", "init", "-q", ".", cwd=K)
sh("git", "-c", "user.email=a@example.com", "-c", "user.name=n", "commit", "-q", "--allow-empty", "-m", "i", cwd=K)
shutil.copy(os.path.join(R, "backlog.json"), K); os.makedirs(os.path.join(K, "kb", "_self", "backlog"))
os.makedirs(os.path.join(T, "bin")); FAKE = os.path.join(T, "bin", "claude"); os.symlink("/bin/sleep", FAKE)
WT = os.path.join(K, ".claude", "worktrees", "agent-ST-aaaaaaaa")
sh("git", "worktree", "add", "-q", "-b", "work/ST-aaaaaaaa", WT, cwd=K)
sid = str(uuid.uuid4())
pdir = os.path.join(C, "projects", "".join(c if c.isalnum() else "-" for c in WT)); os.makedirs(pdir)
with open(os.path.join(pdir, sid + ".jsonl"), "w") as f:
    f.write(json.dumps({"type": "user", "cwd": WT, "sessionId": sid, "timestamp": "2026-10-26T10:00:00Z", "message": {"role": "user", "content": "planted-line"}}) + "\n")
subprocess.run(["sh", "-c", FAKE + " 60 &"], cwd=WT, env=env)
time.sleep(1.0)
try:
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, os.path.join(R, "_tools", "backlog.py"), "procs"], cwd=K, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
    rows = [x for x in r.stdout.splitlines() if " claude " in x]
    print("\n".join(rows) or r.stdout[-300:] + r.stderr[-300:])
finally:
    subprocess.run(["pkill", "-f", FAKE])
sys.exit(0 if rows and all("orphan" not in x for x in rows) else 1)

repro_reason: the end-to-end failure needs a live orphaned claude pid with a fresh transcript; the repro counts callers that pass fresh= to classify
